# `gcp.topic`

A named resource to which messages are sent by publishers.

| Tier | 1 (ruled: Both hooks describe request shapes the generator now builds from the API itself, so neither is left to hand-written code.
encoder (encoders/no_send_name.go.tmpl) deletes `name` from the create body. A topic is created with a PUT to its own path, `v1/{+name}`, and requestBody already leaves out every field the create url names, so `name` is never in the body to begin with.
update_encoder (update_encoder/pubsub_topic.tmpl) wraps the topic, `newObj["topic"] = obj`. That is AIP-134's UpdateTopicRequest{topic, updateMask}, confirmed in the pubsub v1 Discovery document, with the mask REQUIRED and in the body. The generator detects the envelope from the patch request schema and finds the mask by its google-fieldmask format, and the runtime sends exactly that shape.
THE BOUNDED GAP, stated rather than discovered: `name` is the FULL resource name, "projects/<project>/topics/<topic>", in configuration as on the wire. That is what the API's create path and every response use, so state and configuration agree and nothing drifts. magic-modules models it as the short name and rebuilds the path, which is also why its update_url is not used: it names the same address as the API's own patch method, so the update goes there, spelled the API's way.
